newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's Karrie says IPO 60 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's Karrie says IPO 60 times subscribed.

text.p: Computer casing manufacturer Karrie International Holdings Ltd said on Sunday its initial public offering (IPO) of shares had been 60.7 times subscribed.
Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong on December 16, Karrie said in a statement.

Karrie offered 90 million new shares at HK$1.15 each to raise funds to repay short-term bank loans and leasing loans, to upgrade machinery and equipment, and to buy surface mount technology for the manufacture of printed circuit board assemblies.
